title: AI Actors for UGC Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Get AI actor UGC ads from one product photo. Write the line, choose a presenter, and make clips for paid social, product pages, or short-form posts.
h1: Make More UGC Ads with AI Actors
lead: Get a product ad in minutes without booking a creator or studio. Write the line, choose an actor and keep new angles moving before the offer goes stale.

m2.h2: Get a Talking Ad in Minutes
m2.lead: Upload one product photo, write one line and pick a presenter who says it on camera.

steps.sourceHint: One clear product photo is enough to start
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. In a bright bathroom, the selected actor holds the sky-blue moisturizer jar toward the camera, then touches one cheek. Natural creator delivery says: "This is the moisturizer step I keep beside the sink." Sound: her voice and quiet bathroom room tone.

items.d: Upload one clear product photo and get an actor-led ad around the item your customer will receive.

items.t: Write your line and pick an actor
items.d: Write one short line, then choose a face and setting that fit the product and audience.
Download the vertical ad, then swap the actor, hook or offer when you need another angle.

cta_title: Start your next UGC ad with one product photo
cta_lead: Choose an actor, write the line and make a first cut before you spend on a shoot.

faq.a: An AI actor is a generated presenter for a product video. You choose the person, give them a line and review the delivery on camera.

faq.q: How do AI actors turn a script into a video?
faq.a: Write a short line, choose a presenter and generate the clip. The actor's voice and lip movement follow the words you provide.

faq.q: What product photo should I upload?
faq.a: Upload one clear photo that shows the full product, its color and the details the actor needs to hold or explain.
Yes. Choose from 36 adult presenters across different ages, styles and settings, then open the spokesperson workspace with that presenter selected.

faq.q: What sizes and lengths are available?
faq.a: The actor tool starts with a 9:16 vertical clip. The workspace offers 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and this directory starts with 10 seconds.

faq.q: How much does an actor video cost?
faq.a: A 10-second actor video costs 40 credits. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Where can I use videos made with AI actors?
faq.a: Use them as paid social ads, on product pages, in organic social posts and in short product guides after you review the final clip.

faq.q: Is the presenter a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is generated, so do not frame the video as a real customer review and follow the disclosure rules for the platform where you publish it.
